symbol.description: Source symbol tied to a verified declaration, interface member or explicitly declared call-site anchor. The behavior range may be a narrow internal snippet. Do not substitute arbitrary words from the excerpt.
symbol.title: Symbol

behavior.description: TLA+ MODULE Behavior, with Init, Next, vars, and Obs; implementation behavior only
behavior.title: Behavior

properties.description: TLA+ MODULE Properties EXTENDS Behavior, defining obligation and optional goal invariants
properties.title: Properties

constants.description: TLC constant assignments only; no state/action constraints or invariant overrides
constants.title: Constants

source_ids.description: Located materials; file kinds do not establish normative authority
source_ids.title: Source Ids

new_basis.description: For F2, why the old semantic judgment is invalid and what new material establishes
new_basis.title: New Basis

expected_versions.description: Dictionary encoded as unique key/value_json entries; value_json contains a valid JSON value

kind.description: Harness kind advertised by the selected implementation adapter
kind.title: Kind

source.description: Executable experiment source, calling actual target code; no fabricated expected observations
source.title: Source

prerequisite_events.description: Ordered events required for candidate replay; not claims that they occurred
prerequisite_events.title: Prerequisite Events

semantic_changes.description: Instrumentation and adaptation differences; never alter protocol logic to create a real finding
semantic_changes.title: Semantic Changes

original_question.description: The exact stored issue explanation; preserve stable problem identity
original_question.title: Original Question

rationale.description: Why actual evidence answers this specific issue; describing current behavior alone is insufficient
rationale.title: Rationale

residual_issue_ids.description: Other independent open issues that remain; never the resolved issue or its unresolved children
residual_issue_ids.title: Residual Issue Ids

scope_limitations.description: Independent boundaries retained by the related review item
scope_limitations.title: Scope Limitations

fields.description: Model Obs record field to raw state field mapping; direct scalar projection only
fields.title: Fields

required_events.description: Event names that must be present for calibration to be conclusive
required_events.title: Required Events

parameters.description: Dictionary encoded as unique key/value_json entries; value_json contains a valid JSON value

scope_limitations.description: Independent scope boundaries, not unresolved conditions needed for this judgment; never relabel contrary evidence here
scope_limitations.title: Scope Limitations
